audit.whatIsWrong: Frost Armor grants Sejuani immunity to slows while it is up, and it comes back whenever she has been out of combat. Zac's only two slows are Stretching Strikes (Q) and Let's Bounce! (R). Neither layer mentions the interaction anywhere.
audit.why: It is the single decisive interaction in the matchup and it silently deletes half of Zac's kit at the exact moment he wants to open. Every trade in this lane starts against a Sejuani who has been standing in the wave out of combat, so Frost Armor is up, so the Q slow and the R slow do nothing at all on the first cast. The whole 'Q-chain and walk her down' plan the entry sells only starts working after damage has stripped the armour. That reordering — damage first, then the slows land — is the difference between the poke pattern working and the player wondering why she walked away.
audit.corrected: Frost Armor makes her slow-immune out of combat. Break it with damage before you rely on the Q or R slow to hold her; it also re-applies shortly after she leaves combat.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (Fury of the North: 'Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows')
champ-data/_kits/zac.json (slow flags on Q and R)

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Permafrost as the matchup-defining cooldown and instructs 'Engage only on Permafrost's cooldown' in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1], loading and focus. Permafrost is on a 1.5 second cooldown.
audit.why: A 1.5s cooldown is not a window and cannot be played around — the instruction is unfollowable as written. Permafrost is gated by Frost stacks, not by its own cooldown, so the real clock is Winter's Wrath at 9s rank 1 (which applies the stacks) and Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1 (her only gap-close). Pointing the player at a 1.5s timer means he never finds the window that actually exists.
audit.corrected: Permafrost: 1.5s cooldown, but it only fires on a target at maximum Frost stacks. Track Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s), which applies the stacks, and Arctic Assault (18/16.5/15/13.5/12s), her only engage.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (Permafrost cooldown 1.5, 'stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks'; Winter's Wrath 9/8/7/6/5; Arctic Assault 18/16.5/15/13.5/12)

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer conflates two different mechanics under the word 'Passive' in three places: spikes[0].text 'punishes her before she stacks Frost Armor Passive', wants.you[1] 'Punish her before she stacks Frost Armor Passive', whys[2] 'out-trade her before she stacks Passive', and wants.foe[0] 'Stack her Passive stun to lock you'. Frost Armor is not stacked — it is a resistance and slow-immunity buff gained by being out of combat. The thing that stacks is Frost, applied by Winter's Wrath and autos, and it enables Permafrost.
audit.why: Two separate mechanics collapsed into one word means the player cannot act on either. 'Punish her before she stacks Frost Armor' describes something that never happens, so it reads as noise; meanwhile the real stacking mechanic — Frost building toward a Permafrost stun and the passive shatter that follows — is never explained at all.
audit.corrected: Frost Armor: out-of-combat buff, armour + MR + slow immunity, broken by damage. Frost stacks: applied by Winter's Wrath and basic attacks; at maximum, Permafrost stuns, and Sejuani's passive shatters a stunned target for heavy magic damage.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (Fury of the North; Winter's Wrath 'applying Frost stacks'; Permafrost 'maximum Frost stacks')

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[4].why is the shared boilerplate line. content spikes[1].text already reads Glacial Prison correctly as a team ult, but neither gives the number or the targeting rule.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is 120s at rank 1 and stuns only the first champion it hits over 1300 units. Both facts point the same way — it is not a duelling tool — but stated as numbers they also tell the Zac player something actionable: at 6 the duel has not changed, and in a skirmish a body in front of him eats it.
audit.corrected: Glacial Prison: 120/105/90s, 1300-range projectile, stuns the first champion hit. Her level-6 duel is unchanged.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (Glacial Prison cooldown 120/105/90, range 1300, 'freezes and stuns the first champion hit')

audit.why: 59.76% over 82 games against a chart of Zac 4 / Skill 3 / Sejuani 0 is a fair reading of a lane Zac wins without ever dominating a stage outright. No chart change needed here, unlike the flagged matchups.

notes: Best find: Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, and Zac's only two slows are Q and R. Every trade in this lane opens against an out-of-combat Sejuani with Frost Armor up, so the first Q slow and the R slow simply do not hold her — damage has to strip the armour before the kite pattern the entry sells starts working. Nothing in either layer mentioned it. Second: the full layer names Permafrost as the matchup-defining cooldown and tells the player to 'engage on Permafrost's cooldown', but Permafrost is 1.5s — an unfollowable instruction. The real clocks are Winter's Wrath (9s rank 1, applies the Frost stacks that arm Permafrost) and Arctic Assault (18s rank 1, her only gap-close). Third: the content layer uses the word 'Passive' for two different mechanics — Frost Armor (out-of-combat resists, never 'stacked') and Frost stacks (the Permafrost enabler) — in four places.
